verdict.rationale: Community reports say non-programmers build Zapier automations themselves and that Zaps support multiple triggers and actions, unlike IFTTT's single step. Users also describe the interface as intuitive. First-party material covers Zap workflows (troubleshooting docs) and Canvas visual process mapping that feeds into automation. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the Zap editor's visual multi-step building (the 'Visual Builder' docs cover integration development, not workflows), and detail on branching or conditional logic in the visual editor.
